items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: That's here, Phillip and Living. A brick church right there.

ctx.x: Do you remember Providence Hall? There's a building, it's a church right over here someplace now. Who? Was it called Providence Hall, Old Providence Hall? I know. On Phillip Street. Wait, wait.
That's here, Phillip and Living. A brick church right there.
That's the one, isn't it? Yeah, that's it.
